prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: soggy marsh grass on peat: dark olive grass clumps with wet dark gaps and small reeds The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Generate a square seamless tileable pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: soggy marsh grass over peat, dark olive irregular grass clumps, wet dark peat gaps, tiny scattered reeds. Surface fills entire square uniformly, no border or focal point. Premium modern hi-bit 2D JRPG pixel art, hand-placed crisp uniformly sized square pixels and clear 3–10-pixel clusters, strictly no antialiasing, blur, brushes, photographic texture, random noise or checkerboard dithering. Rich earthy hue-shifted ramps of 4–6 shades per material: saturated purple-red leaning shadows, warm yellow leaning highlights. Orthographic straight-down/steep classic RPG map camera, no perspective convergence. Soft neutral even overcast-evening base color lighting from upper left; no cast shadows, nighttime darkness, light sources, glow, lamp pools or vignette. Make edges precisely seamless: left matches right, top matches bottom, with continuous vegetation and peat patterns crossing seams. No objects, characters, text, frames, paths or water pools. Pixel sizes consistent everywhere.
